name: POW Probe
description: Tests whether POW is the stat behind basic-attack damage. Rock Salt (a battle consumable that normally grants POW +10) is amplified to POW +150 and sold for 1 ring in every shop. Use it mid-battle and compare your basic attack before and after. If damage jumps, POW drives attack damage; if only the POW readout on the character sheet moves and damage does not, it does not. Nothing else differs from the playthrough build.

edits.text: TEST ITEM. Grants POW +150 for the battle. Use it, then attack, and compare the damage.
